name: select
title: Select
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Select. The trigger is drawn like Input with a brush chevron that turns in two steps. The list is a case (3px ink line, tone shadow) with a notch toward the trigger, popping in over three frames. The highlighted option inverts to ink; the chosen option gets a brush check that draws itself. Group labels are underlined lettering; disabled options keep the label with a dashed underline. Adds SelectEmpty (a “…” mark) and SelectLoading (turning concentration lines).
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/select". It wraps your own components/ui/select, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: An ink-lined trigger; the list pops in as a notched case.
meta.usage:
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/manga/select"

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="Pick a volume" /></SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="v1">Vol. 1</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="v2">Vol. 2</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>

props.name: SelectEmpty
props.description: Empty list: a “…” mark and a short line.

props.name: SelectLoading
props.description: While options load: turning concentration lines.
